EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Das geht ein Kind nichts an! Und jetzt verschwinde von hier!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_33
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: Alright, hurry on home, then!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: ほら さっさとお家に帰る！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Also gut, dann lauf schnell nach Hause!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_34
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: All's well around town... It's just another... peaceful night.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: 町に異常… なし…今宵も… 平和な町である…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Alles in Ordnung in der Stadt... Nur eine weitere, friedliche Nacht.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_40
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: Children shouldn't be out at this hour! Especially with everything that's happened... With the princess missing...and the king—Go home already! Don't make me tell you again!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: 子供が こんな時間に町をウロウロするんじゃない！王があんなことになって…姫様の安否も わからないってのに…さぁさぁ 子供はもう寝る時間だ帰った帰った！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Kinder sollten um diese Zeit nicht draußen sein!Insbesondere bei all dem, was passiert ist... Die Prinzessin verschwunden... und der König –Geh endlich nach Hause! Wehe, ich muss es dir noch mal sagen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_41
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: If he attacks now, we'll be finished...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: もし… アイツが我々を襲ってきたら…この町は終わるだろう…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Wenn er jetzt angreift... sind wir am Ende...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_42
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: You again? ! Get outta here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: …またお前か！ほら 帰った帰った！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Du schon wieder? ! Geh mir aus den Augen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_43
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: You're still hanging around? I thought I told you to get outta here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: まだいたのか！ほら 帰った帰った！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Du bist immer noch hier? Ich hatte dir doch gesagt, dass du verschwinden sollst!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: Talk_44
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: I wonder where the princess could be... But more than that, I hope she's safe...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: 姫様は ご無事だろうか…どこで何を されているのだろうか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Ich frage mich, wo die Prinzessin sein könnte... Aber mehr noch hoffe ich, dass es ihr gut geht...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: TerrorSword_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: What're you trying to do? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: 何をしている！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Was machst du da? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: TerrorSword_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: Hey!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: おい！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Hey!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.Label: TerrorSword_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.USenText: I WILL confiscate that!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.JPjaText: 取り上げるぞ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_005_Child.EUdeText: Das beschlagnahme ich!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Wakey, wakey!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 起きて～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Wach auf!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Sweet dreams...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: おやすみなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Süße Träume...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: GlassTruth
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Mmmuh...Huh? Gramps? I thought you died! Oh, sorry. Those goggles looked just like my grandpa's reading glasses for a second.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: んあ…あれ… 亡くなったじーちゃん…？…なワケ ねーよなその派手なメガネじーちゃんの老眼鏡に そっくりでさ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Mmmh...Huch? Opa? Ich dachte, du wärst tot!Oh, entschuldige. Diese Brille sah für einen Moment aus wie die Lesebrille meines Opas.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Oh, are you wearing that mask to play pretend? Ah, to be a kid...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: おぉ？ お面遊び…？子供は無邪気だなぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Oh, spielst du etwa mit Masken? Hach, noch einmal Kind sein...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Whoa! That's one scary mask!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: わっ！ ビビった～ お面かよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Uwah! Das ist ja eine unheimliche Maske!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: That's one horrifying mask... You should go show it to my partner over there.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 怖いお面だねぇ…それ被ったまま 横の兵士さんに話しかけてみな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Das ist ja eine furchtbare Maske, die du da trägst... Du solltest sie mal meinem Partner da drüben zeigen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: What's that you've got on your head? It's all fluffy and cute-looking.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: その頭 なんだ？ふわふわして かわいいね
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Was hast du denn da auf deinem Kopf? Das sieht ganz flauschig und niedlich aus.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: So sleepy... Maybe I can sleep with just one eye and stay awake with the other one... Is that how it works?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ………眠い右半身は寝て 左半身だけ仕事 とかできねーかな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: So müde... Vielleicht kann ich ja bloß ein Auge zumachen und so halb wach bleiben... Ob das funktioniert?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_05_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Youth is wasted on the young... If I could go back in time to when I was a kid, I'd sleep in as much as I could get away with!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 子供は気楽でいいよなぁ…子供の頃に戻って 好きなだけ寝たいよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Die Jugend ist an die Jungen verschwendet... Wenn ich in meine Kindheit zurückreisen könnte, würde ich so viel schlafen wie möglich!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_05_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: After being up all night working my shift, I'm always so wide awake afterward that I struggle to fall asleep...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 夜勤明けって 寝ようと思っても目が冴えて なかなか眠れないんだよね…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Nach einer Nachtschicht bin ich immer so hellwach, dass ich kaum einschlafen kann...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Huh? What's a Goron like you doing here? Oh, it's just a mask...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: あれ… ゴロン族？ああ お面か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Was macht denn ein Gorone hier? Oh, das ist ja nur eine Maske...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Huh? What's a Zora like you doing here? Oh, it's just a mask...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: あれ… ゾーラ族？ああ お面か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Was macht denn ein Zora hier? Oh, das ist ja nur eine Maske...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_08_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Hey there. People around here may not think it's very funny to wear a Gerudo Mask right now.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: こらこら 今の時期 ゲルドのお面はシャレにならないから やめた方がいいぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Hey, hör mal. Die Leute hier könnten es nicht so lustig finden, wenn jemand gerade eine Gerudo-Maske trägt.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Er, actually... If I get caught chatting, I'll get in trouble. So, I've gotta get back to work...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: あ… 雑談してたら 怒られちゃう仕事仕事…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ähm, wenn ich beim Schwätzen erwischt werde, bekomme ich Ärger. Ich sollte zurück an die Arbeit gehen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: What do you need?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ぼうや どうした
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Was brauchst du?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Huh? Princess Zelda? What are you doing here? Oh, it's just a mask...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: あれ… ゼルダ姫？ああ お面か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Prinzessin Zelda? Hier? Oh, es ist bloß eine Maske...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Huh? My younger self? What're you doing here? Oh, it's just a mask...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: あれ… 子供の頃の俺？ああ お面か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Nanu? Mein jüngeres Ich? Was machst du denn hier? Ach, es ist nur eine Maske...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Mask_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Huh? Mom? What are you doing here? Oh, it's just a mask...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: あれ… 母ちゃん？ああ お面か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Nanu? Mama? Was machst du denn hier? Oh, es ist nur eine Maske...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: *yawn* I took a nap during the day, but I always get so sleepy when I'm on the night shift.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ふぁ～あ… 昼寝てるはずなのに夜の警備って 眠くなるんだよな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Gähn... Ich habe tagsüber zwar ein Nickerchen gemacht, aber ich werde während der Nachtschicht trotzdem immer so müde.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: It's fiiiinnally morning! Time to go home and get some sleep!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: や～～～っと 朝だ帰ったら 寝るぞ～！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Es ist eeeeeendlich Morgen! Zeit, nach Hause zu gehen und etwas zu schlafen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: *yawn* So sleepy... With things feeling so peaceful, why do we need around-the-clock guard?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ふぁ～あ… ねっむ……こんな平和なのに 深夜の警備なんて要るかね…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Gähn... Bin ich müde. Warum brauchen wir jetzt, wo alles wieder friedlich scheint, eine Rund-um- die-Uhr-Bewachung?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Phew! Another night spent hard at work! Impressive focus as usual, self!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: う～～～ん！ よく働いたっと！偉いぞ～ 俺！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Uff! Wieder eine Nacht lang hart gearbeitet! Mir fielen nicht ein einziges Mal die Augen zu, welch eine Glanzleistung!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_100
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Hey, stop!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: やめなさい！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Hey, stopp!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: That's enough of that! If I catch you doing that again, I'm gonna be really mad, alright?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: やりすぎだぞ！次やったら 本気で怒るからね？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Schluss damit! Wenn du das noch mal versuchst, werde ich wirklich wütend, ist das klar?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Alright, that's enough!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ふざけるのも 大概にしろ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: So, das reicht jetzt!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I told you I was gonna be really mad, didn't I? ! Don't let me catch you again!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 本気で怒る って言っただろ！二度とやるんじゃないぞ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich habe dir gesagt, dass ich wirklich wütend werde, oder? ! Lass dich nicht noch mal von mir erwischen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Mommm! You let me sleep in too late again! Uhh... I mean...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: …ンガッ！か 母ちゃん！ もっと早く起こしてって…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Mamaaaaa! Du hast mich schon wieder verschlafen lassen! Ähm... Ich meine...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Sorry, sir! Er, wait... Huh? ...Ahem! Good little children should be at home and in bed at this hour.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: すいません！ …って あっ 違っ…？……ゴホンッ！ さあ 良い子は帰って おやすみだよ～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Tut mir leid, der Herr! Ähm, Moment... Huch? Ähem... Brave Kinder sollten um diese Zeit zu Hause im Bett sein.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Mimimimi...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: むにゃむにゃ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Hmmhmm...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_17
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Should you be out wandering around at this hour?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: こんな時間に 散歩なんかしてて大丈夫なのかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Solltest du um diese Uhrzeit draußen herumlaufen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_18
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: You should hurry home... Your parents...will be so...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 親が心配す… る……
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Lauf nach Hause... Deine Eltern werden sich Sorgen machen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_19
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I need to get home quick after my shift and stop staying up so late...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 夜遊びはほどほどにして 早く帰らないと…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich sollte nach meiner Schicht direkt nach Hause gehen und nicht immer so lang wach bleiben...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_20
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I'm not sleeping! I'm just...resting my eyes.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 俺は 眠ってないぞ目をつむってただけだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich schlafe nicht! Ich ruhe nur... meine Augen aus.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I'm so sleepy... It's like there's a giant Goron sitting on my eyelids...So heavy...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 眠たい… まるでまぶたに… 太ったゴロン族が 乗っているよう…だ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich bin so müde... Als ob ein riesiger Gorone auf meinen Lidern sitzen würde...So schwer...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_22
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: So...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Müde...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_23
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Ahem! Head on home like a good kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ………ゴホンッ！ さあ 子供はもう帰りましょうね～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ähm... Sei ein braves Kind und geh nach Hause!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_24
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Ughhh... I'm so tired... I would've taken a proper nap earlier if I knew I'd be this sleepy.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: クソッ 眠い…こんなことなら たっぷり昼寝すりゃよかった
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Auweia... Ich bin so müde... Ich hätte vorhin ein richtiges Nickerchen gemacht, wenn ich gewusst hätte, dass ich so müde sein würde.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_25
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I'm so sleepy... But I can't get caught dozing off, or I'll get in trouble...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: うう 眠い…でも 居眠りがバレたら 大目玉をくらっちまう…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich bin so müde... Aber wenn man mich beim Einschlafen erwischt, bekomme ich Ärger...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_26
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I bet you thought I fell asleep just now, right? Well...I was actually just trying to focus.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 俺が寝てると思っただろ？ちょっと 精神統一してただけだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich wette, du dachtest, ich würde jetzt einschlafen, oder? Ich habe bloß versucht, mich zu konzentrieren.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_29
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: *gasp* Captain! No! I'm not falling asleep, sir...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: …ンゴッ！ハッ！ 隊長！ 決して居眠りなんか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Oje! Hauptmann! Nein! Ich schlafe nicht ein...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_30
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: *sigh* I only closed my eyes for a second... What happened?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: はぁ… ちょっと目をつむってた間にまさか あんなことになるなんて…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Oje... Ich habe meine Augen bloß für eine Sekunde geschlossen... Was ist passiert?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_32
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: *sigh* I'm glad we had another peaceful shift.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: はぁ… 今日は 何事も無くてよかった…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich bin froh, dass wir eine weitere ruhige Schicht hatten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_33
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Ugh... Even now, I'm so tired, I could just go to sleep right here...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: くぅ… こんな状況だってのに眠気には 抗え… ない…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Uff... Selbst jetzt bin ich noch so müde, dass ich direkt hier einschlafen könnte...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_34
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Whew... Night shifts are no joke!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: ふぅ～… 夜勤はキツいな～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Puh... Nachtschichten sind nicht ohne!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_36
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: You thought I was dozing off? Don't be rude. I just had my eyes closed for a second.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 居眠りしてるとでも思ったか？ 失礼な奴めちょっと目をつむってただけだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Dachtest du, ich schlafe ein? Jetzt hör mal. Ich hatte meine Augen nur für eine Sekunde geschlossen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_37
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I'm not sleeping. How could I possibly sleep at a time like this?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: …俺は 眠ってないぞこんな時に 眠れるわけないだろう
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich schlafe nicht! Wie könnte ich zu dieser Zeit nur schlafen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_38
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: Zzz... Zzz...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: スー… スー…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Zzz... Zzz...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_39
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: How is it possible to be this sleepy, given the situation... I'm...so sleepy...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 人間ってのは こんな状況でも眠たくなるもん… なんだ…なぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Wie kann es nur sein, dass man in einer Situation wie dieser so müde werden kann... So unfassbar......müde...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_40
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: My shift is over for the night. Come find me when I'm on duty if you want to chat.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: やっと夜勤が明けたよまた今度 お話しよう
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Meine Nachtschicht ist vorbei. Komm zu mir, wenn ich wieder Dienst habe, wenn du mit mir reden möchtest.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.Label: Talk_41
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.USenText: I'm going back to my cot to sleep. I can't chat with you right now, sorry.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.JPjaText: 今から宿舎に戻って寝るんだ邪魔しないでね
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_006_Child.EUdeText: Ich gehe zurück in mein Bettchen zum Schlafen. Daher kann ich jetzt nicht mit dir plaudern, tut mir leid.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: GlassTruth
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! What's with those goggles? No way a kid like you could afford a stylish pair like those.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ なんだそのメガネお金持ち気取りか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Was soll denn diese Brille? Ein Kind wie du könnte sich doch niemals so eine leisten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: What's that mask? Can you even see?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: なんだそのお面？ちゃんと見えてんのか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Was ist das für eine Maske? Kannst du damit überhaupt etwas sehen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! Is that a monster mask? Children are so innocent, aren't they?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ… 魔物のお面かい？子供は無邪気でいーよなー
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Ist das eine Monstermaske? Ja, als Kind denkt man sich wohl nichts dabei...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! That mask is blocking your nose, kid. Can you even breathe?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ… お面で鼻が塞がってるぞ苦しくないのか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Die Maske verstopft deine Nase, Kleiner. Kannst du damit überhaupt atmen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! That hood kinda makes it look like you have four ears.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ… ずきんのおかげで 耳が4つあるぞ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Mit dieser Kopfbedeckung siehst du aus, als hättest du vier Ohren.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Guards... Soldiers... Heroes... It's their fault there's so much peace around here. Hm... What if I...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: オレが仕事してるから 町の平和が保たれてるんだたぶん…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Wachen... Soldaten... Helden... Sie sind schuld daran, dass es hier so friedlich ist... Hm... Wie wäre es, wenn ich...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_05_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Oh, a child in a mask... So innocent. I'm jealous.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 子供か… お面なんかしちゃって無邪気で 羨ましいよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Oh, ein Kind mit einer Maske... So unschuldig. Ich bin neidisch.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Huh? Is that a monster mask, or... Oh! A Goron!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ん？ 魔物のお面か？あ ゴロン族か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Ist das eine Monstermaske oder... Oh! Ein Gorone!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Huh? Is that a monster mask, or... Oh! A Zora!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ん？ 魔物のお面か？あ ゾーラ族か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Ist das eine Monstermaske oder... Oh! Ein Zora!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Hm? What kind of mask is that? Oh! It's a Gerudo!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ん？ なんのお面だ？あ ゲルド族か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Hm? Was für eine Maske ist das? Oh! Eine Gerudo!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Anyway...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: おっと そんなことより… だ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Wie dem auch sei...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Huh? Back again?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: んあ？ ああ いたのか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Du bist wieder da?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! Is that a Princess Zelda mask? Striking but not as much as Her Highness.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ… ゼルダ姫のお面か？本物はもっと きれいだぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Ist das eine Prinzessin-Zelda-Maske? Sieht schön aus, aber nicht so edel wie Ihre Hoheit.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! What kind of mask is that? Is it some celebrity?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ… なんだそのお面有名人か？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Was für eine Maske ist das? Soll das eine Berühmtheit sein?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Mask_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Haha! What kind of mask is that? It's not scary at all.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ははっ なんだそのお面全然 怖くないぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Was für eine Maske ist das? Die ist ja überhaupt nicht gruselig.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: I'm bored...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 退屈だ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Mir ist langweilig...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Ugh, so bored...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ヒマすぎる…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Uff, so langweilig...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Hmm...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: う～む…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Hmm...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: *sigh*
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: はぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Hach...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: It's finally time to switch.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: やっと交代だ～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Endlich Schichtwechsel.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Did something happen?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: なんかあったのかな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ist etwas passiert?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Is the castle alright?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 城は いいのかな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ist im Schloss alles gut?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: What a drag...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 辛い…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ist das öde...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: I'm tired.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 疲れた…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ich bin müde.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: What's going on?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 何が起こってんだ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Was ist los?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Near_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Someone tell me...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 誰か教えて…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Erklärt mir das jemand?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: *sigh* I'm bored...If only there was a bit more chaos around here... Yeah... That'd be way more exciting.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: はぁ～ 退屈だ…世の中 少しはもめ事があった方が刺激的で 楽しいはずだよな～…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Mir ist so langweilig...Wenn es hier nur etwas mehr Chaos gäbe... Ja, dann wäre alles aufregender.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Wait, you didn't hear that, did you? Hah... Keep it between us, will ya? Say... I was about to break some pots to pass the time. Care to join?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 今の聞かれちゃった？へへ… ここだけの話にしといてくれよな今から退屈しのぎに ツボ割りでもしようかと思ってんだけど… オマエも やってく？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Moment mal, das hast du nicht gehört, oder? Hehe... Das bleibt unter uns, ja? Sag mal... Ich wollte gerade ein paar Krüge zerschlagen, um mir die Zeit zu vertreiben. Willst du mitmachen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Throw 'em, slash 'em, whatever. They're gonna get thrown out anyway, so feel free to destroy!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 持って投げたり 剣で砕いたり…どうせ捨てるし 割ってストレス解消するんだ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Wirf sie, zerschlag sie, was auch immer. Sie werden eh entsorgt, also zerstör sie ruhig!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Smash away, and say goodbye to stress! We're getting rid of them anyway, so don't hold back!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 割って割って ストレスとおさらばさ！どうせ壊して捨てるツボだ 遠慮は要らないぜ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Zerschlag sie und bau so Stress ab! Wir entsorgen sie sowieso, also nur zu!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Breaking pots is a great way to relieve stress! You can throw 'em, smash 'em, or even use your sword to break a bunch at once! They're gonna get thrown out anyway. Try it, kid...I'll pretend I didn't see anything.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ストレス解消には ツボ割りが一番だ！ツボを放り投げて割るのもよし！剣を振り回して いっぺんに砕くのもよし！どうせ壊して捨てるツボだ！ボウズもやってみな…見て見ぬふり しといてやるからさ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Krüge zerschlagen ist großartig, um Stress abzubauen!Du kannst sie werfen, zerschlagen oder sogar mehrere auf einmal mit deinem Schwert zerstören!Die sollen sowieso entsorgt werden. Versuch’s mal, Kleiner...Ich tu so, als ob ich nichts gesehen hätte.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Ugh, so boring... I wish we had a little more chaos...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: あ～ 退屈だ 退屈…もめ事でも起きねぇかな～…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Puh, ist das langweilig... Ich wünschte, wir hätten etwas mehr Chaos...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: What? ! Kid, are you eavesdropping again? Hehe... Just pretend you didn't hear that.Anyway, I could use a break. Wanna smash some pots?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ぬぉ！？ ボウズ また 盗み聞きかい？ へへ… 聞かなかったことにしてくれよ退屈で ストレスもたまってきたところだだから ツボ割りでもやっていかねぇか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Wie? ! Hast du schon wieder gelauscht, Kleiner? Hehe... Tu einfach so, als hättest du nichts gehört.Ich könnte jedenfalls eine Pause gebrauchen. Willst du ein paar Krüge zerschmettern?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Hey! Looks like you're a natural pot breaker! Feels pretty good, doesn't it? In here, you can break as many as you like!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ボウズ ツボを割ったみたいだな！スッキリするだろ～！ここのツボなら いくらでも割っていいからな！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Hey! Sieht aus, als wärst du ein Naturtalent im Krügezerschmettern! Macht Spaß, oder? Hier drin kannst du so viele zerschmettern, wie du willst!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_100
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Isn't it about time for you to go home, kid?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ボウズは そろそろ帰る時間じゃないのか？ん？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Solltest du nicht langsam mal nach Hause gehen, Kleiner?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: My shift is finally over... If you need something, find me tomorrow.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: やっと交代の時間なんだ…用があるなら また明日な
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Meine Schicht ist endlich rum... Wenn du etwas brauchst, findest du mich morgen wieder hier.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Not now, kid. I've got guard duty in the storeroom.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: ボウズはあっちに行ってなオレは今から 物置の警備なんだ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Nicht jetzt, Kleiner. Ich muss Wache im Lagerraum schieben...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: What is it, kid? I don't have anything for you.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: なんだボウズ…オレについて来ても 面白いことなんて無いぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Was gibt es, Kleiner? Ich habe nichts für dich.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_104
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: With me being stuck in the storeroom, I don't hear any news about the castle...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 物置に突っ立ってるだけだったから城の情報が入って来ないや…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Da ich im Lagerraum feststecke, höre ich gar keine Neuigkeiten über das Schloss...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_105
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Should I really be guarding the storeroom at a time like this? Well... I guess orders are orders.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: こんな状況なのに 物置の警備してていいのか？いいなら いいけど…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Sollte ich in Zeiten wie diesen wirklich den Lagerraum bewachen? Nun... ich schätze, Befehl ist Befehl.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_106
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Did something happen at the castle? I don't mind guarding the storeroom...But the higher-ups aren't telling me anything...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 物置の見張りに行くのは いいけどよ…城の中で 何か起こったんじゃないのか？上の人は 何も教えてくれないし…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Es macht mir nichts aus, den Lagerraum zu bewachen, aber ich glaube, im Schloss ist etwas passiert.Meine Vorgesetzten erzählen mir gar nichts...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_107
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Something happened in the castle, but no one told me what it was.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 何か城であったようだけど 何が起こったのか結局 誰も教えてくれなかったな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Irgendwas ist im Schloss vorgefallen, aber keiner erzählt mir, was los ist.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_108
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: My work keeps me in either the lodging house or the storeroom. What's happening in the castle?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 宿舎と物置を 往復する毎日…これじゃ 城の中で何が起こったのか わかんないよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Meine Arbeit hält mich entweder im Gästehaus oder im Lagerraum gefangen. Was ist im Schloss los?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_109
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: I heard it's hectic inside the castle. I wonder if I'm guarding the storeroom again tomorrow.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 城の中は 大変なはずだがまた明日も 物置の見張りなのかなぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ich habe gehört, es gab Aufruhr im Schloss. Ob ich wohl morgen wieder den Lagerraum bewachen soll?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: I wanted to break a few myself, but... Ah well!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: オレの分が無くなっちまったけどよ…ま いいだろう！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ich hätte ja selbst gern ein paar zerschmettert, aber... Na ja!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_110
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: I should go to bed early and prepare for tomorrow.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 明日に備えて 今日は早めに寝よう毎日 早めに寝てるけど…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ich sollte früh ins Bett gehen und mich auf morgen vorbereiten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_111
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: *sigh* I guess it's the storeroom again for me tomorrow...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: また明日も 物置の見張りか…はぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ich schätze, ich muss morgen wieder den Lagerraum bewachen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: See! Clearing clutter lifts your spirits!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 部屋が スッキリすると気分も上がってくるよな！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Siehst du! Ordnung schaffen hebt die Stimmung!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: But it does seem a little bare in here now.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …ちょっと 殺風景すぎる気もするけど
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Allerdings ist es hier drinnen jetzt etwas karg...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: But how stressed does a kid have to be to break everything? Should I be worried?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …隅々まで割っちゃうなんてどんだけストレスたまってんだ… 心配になってきたぞ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Aber wie gestresst muss ein Kind sein, wenn es hier alles zerschmettert? Ob ich mir Sorgen machen sollte?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Oh, you've already started.Well, no need to hold back! They'll get broken and tossed out eventually anyway.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …って もう割っちゃってるなまあいい どうせ壊して捨てるツボだ遠慮は要らないぜ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Oh, du hast schon angefangen!Na gut. Sie werden sowieso bald weggeworfen, also musst du dich nicht zurückhalten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: What? ! There aren't any pots left! But there were so many... What happened? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …って ツボが無い！！あんなにあったはずなのに…いつの間に…！？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Was? ! Es sind keine Krüge mehr da? !Aber es waren so viele... Was ist passiert? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_17
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Huh? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Huch? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_18
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: The pots... They're gone! There's not even a single one left!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …ツボが 1つも… 無い…！！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Die Krüge... Sie sind weg! Nicht ein einziger ist noch übrig!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_19
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Oh, but don't do this anywhere else.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …あ でもここ以外でこんなことしたら ダメだからね
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Oh... Aber mach das bloß nirgendwo anders.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_20
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Oh, but if you get in trouble for throwing them at someone, don't look at me.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …あ でも人にぶつけて怒られても 責任は持たないからね
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Oh, aber wenn du Ärger bekommst, weil du sie auf jemanden geworfen hast, habe ich nichts damit zu tun.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_201
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Ugh... When I'm bored like this, I like to sing my breaking-pots song.♪Grab the pot, lift it up, throw it, and break it... Grab the pot, lift it up, throw it, and break it...♪
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 退屈だ…こんな時は ツボ割りのことを考えようツボをつかんで持ち上げて 放り投げて割る…ツボをつかんで持ち上げて 放り投げて割る…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Hrmpf... Wenn ich so gelangweilt wie jetzt bin, sing ich gerne meine Lieder übers Zerbrechen von Krügen.♪ Nimm den Krug, heb ihn hoch, wirf ihn und zerbrich ihn... Nimm den Krug, heb ihn hoch, wirf ihn und zerbrich ihn... ♪

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_202
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Heh... That was certainly a commotion, wasn't it?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 町は今日も平和だなーハハハ…！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Das war ja ein ziemlicher Trubel, oder?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_203
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: *sigh* So bored... I wonder if my friends outside are at least having fun.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: う～ん ヒマだ…外の仲間は 華々しく活躍してるのかな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ist das langweilig... Ob meine Freunde draußen wohl wenigstens Spaß haben?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Ugh... I don't want to guard the storeroom.Maybe I'll just smash the pots here to kill time...You can do it too, kid. They're just going to throw them out anyway.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: 物置の見張りなんて やってらんねーよなヒマ潰しにここのツボ 全部割っちまおうかな…ボウズもやっていいぜどうせ 捨てるヤツだしな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Uff... Ich will den Lagerraum nicht bewachen.Vielleicht zerschlage ich einfach alle Krüge hier, um mir die Zeit zu vertreiben...Du darfst auch, Kleiner. Die Krüge hier sollen sowieso entsorgt werden.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_22
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: ...Actually, doesn't look like they've been restocked yet.Someone will soon though, so come back later.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: …って そういやツボの補充がまだだったなそのうち誰かが補充してくれるからまた別の機会に 割りにおいでよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Sieht nicht so aus, als wären schon neue Krüge hingestellt worden.Irgendwer wird es schon machen. Komm einfach später wieder.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_23
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: But...after we smash them all, I'll just be bored again...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: まぁ 全部割ったあとはまた退屈な時間に 戻っちまうんだけどな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Aber... Wenn wir sie alle zerschlagen haben, wird mir direkt wieder langweilig sein...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_24
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: *sigh* So boring...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: はぁ～ 退屈だ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ach... Ist das langweilig...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_25
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: *sigh* Back to boring old work...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: はぁ～ また退屈な時間に 逆戻りか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Gnarf... Zurück zur langweiligen Arbeit...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_300
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Hey!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: コラ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Hey!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_301
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Too far, kid! If you're going to pull pranks, do it on the pots!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: さすがに やりすぎだどうせイタズラするなら ツボにしときな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Du gehst zu weit, Kleiner! Wenn du Streiche spielen willst, mach das mit den Krügen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_302
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: Enough!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: いい加減にしろ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Es reicht!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.Label: Talk_303
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.USenText: I told you to stop! Adults can only take so much teasing!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.JPjaText: やめろ って言っただろ！大人をからかうのにも 限度があるぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_007_Child.EUdeText: Ich hab dir gesagt, dass du aufhören sollst! Erwachsene halten nur eine gewisse Menge an Streichen aus!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: What is this place?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ここって？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Was ist das hier?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Where is the castle?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ハイラル城に行きたい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Wo ist das Schloss?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Never mind.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: なんでもない
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Nein, danke.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Bye.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: さようなら
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Wiedersehen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: What happened?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 何があったの？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Was ist passiert?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Tell me about town.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 町の説明をしてほしい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Erzähl vom Ort hier.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Yes, please.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: お願いします！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ja, bitte.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: I'm good.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 間に合ってます
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Alles gut.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: GlassTruth
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Whoa. Those are some strange goggles.I've always had good eyesight, so I've never needed goggles.But anyway, what were we talking about?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おや… 変わったメガネだねオジさんは生まれつき目がいいからメガネとは 縁が無いなぁおっと 話が逸れてしまった…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Holla... Das ist ja eine seltsame Brille.Meine Augen waren immer gut, daher habe ich nie eine Brille gebraucht.Äh, wie dem auch sei... Worüber hatten wir noch gerade gesprochen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: That mask is popular with you kids, isn't it? It suits you!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: そのお面って 子供に人気のやつじゃないか似合ってるぞ～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Diese Maske ist gerade in bei euch Kindern, oder? Sie steht dir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_01_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Isn't that a Keaton Mask? I think my friend wanted one of those.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: そのお面 キータンのお面… だったか？仲間が 欲しがってたっけ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ist das nicht eine Keaton-Maske? Ich glaube, mein Freund wollte so eine haben.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Wow, that's a cool mask. It looks strong.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おぉ かっこいいお面だね強そうに見えるぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Wow, das ist ja eine tolle Maske. Die sieht ziemlich stark aus.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Wow, what a scary mask. Looks like something you pulled out of a graveyard.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おぉ… 恐ろしいお面だね墓地とかに出てきそうだな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Wow, was für eine unheimliche Maske. Sieht aus wie etwas, das auf einem Friedhof ausgegraben wurde.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Is that some sort of rabbit headband? Looks good.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ウサギの被り物かい？似合ってるね～
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ist das eine Art Hasenreif? Sieht gut aus.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_05_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: What a creepy mask...He can't read my mind, right? Don't want anyone knowing I'm glad I'm not the princess's bodyguard...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: それにしても 薄気味悪いお面だな…「姫様の警護役じゃなくて よかったー」とか思ってるの バレてたりして…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Was für eine unheimliche Maske...Er kann meine Gedanken nicht lesen, oder? Ich will nicht, dass irgendjemand mitkriegt, dass ich froh bin, nicht der Leibwächter der Prinzessin zu sein...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_05_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Ganondorf is terrifying... I'm glad I'm not guarding the castle.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ガノンドロフこえぇー…城の警護じゃなくてよかった…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ganondorf ist furchterregend... Bin ich froh, dass ich nicht das Schloss bewachen muss...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, a Goron Mask. Have you ever been to Goron City?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おや ゴロン族のお面かぁゴロンシティに 行ったことあるのかな？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, eine Goronenmaske. Warst du schon mal in Goronia?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, a Zora Mask. Have you ever been to Zora Domain?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おや ゾーラ族のお面かぁゾーラの里に 行ったことあるのかな？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, eine Zora-Maske. Warst du schon mal im Dorf der Zoras?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_08_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: A Gerudo, huh? Even if it is just a mask, I think I've had enough of them for a while...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: む ゲルドのお面か…お面でも ゲルド族はもう勘弁してほしいぜ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Eine Gerudo, hm? Auch wenn es nur eine Maske ist, hab ich erst mal genug von ihnen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: I've got to work, but I'm happy to talk with you.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: もっと 話をしたいけどオジさん お仕事させてもらうね
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ich muss arbeiten, aber ich unterhalte mich gerne mit dir.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_09_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh yeah, I'm supposed to be working...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おっと 仕事中だった…おしゃべりは やめておこう…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ach ja, ich sollte eigentlich arbeiten...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, it's a mask of Princess Zelda. Well, it's certainly well made.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おや ゼルダ姫のお面だね違う？ よくできてるなぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, eine Maske von Prinzessin Zelda. Nun, sie ist wirklich gut gemacht.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, I feel like I've seen that mask somewhere before. Hmm... Maybe it's just my imagination...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おや どこかで見たことのあるお面だね気のせいかな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, ich habe das Gefühl, als hätte ich diese Maske schon mal gesehen. Hmm... Vielleicht bilde ich mir das auch nur ein...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Mask_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, I've never seen this mask before. I didn't know they had things like that now.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: おや 見たこと無いお面だね今は そんなのがあるんだね
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, diese Maske habe ich noch nie gesehen. Ich wusste nicht, dass es jetzt auch solche gibt.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Near_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: What nice weather.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: いい天気だ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Schönes Wetter...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Near_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Nothing unusual here.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 異常無し…！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Nichts Ungewöhnliches.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Near_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: This is bad...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: まずいことになった…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Das ist nicht gut...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Near_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Please, try to stay calm.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 落ち着いてください…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Bitte bleibt ruhig...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hmm? I haven't seen you around.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ん？ 見かけない子だな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Hmm? Dich habe ich hier noch nie gesehen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hey, it's the out-of-towner!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ああキミは 町の外から来た子だったな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ah, der Fremde!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Do you need something?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 何か困ったことが あるのかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Brauchst du Hilfe?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Alright, listen carefully.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: よかろう では あちらを見てごらん
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Also, hör gut zu.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Do you have any questions for me?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: オジさんに まだ用があったかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Hast du Fragen an mich?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Anything else I can help you with?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 他に聞きたいことは？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Kann ich dir sonst noch helfen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: This is Hyrule Castle Town, nestled just below the great Hyrule Castle itself.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ここはハイラル城の城下町である
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Das hier ist Hyrule-Stadt, die Stadt, die sich direkt unterhalb von Schloss Hyrule befindet.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_100
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Now isn't the time to wander around, kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 今はあまりウロウロしない方がいいぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Jetzt ist nicht der richtige Zeitpunkt zum Herumstreunen, Kleiner.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hey, kid, get home and try to stay quiet.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ぼうず 今は 家で大人しくしてなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Hey, Kleiner... geh heim und verhalt dich ruhig.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_106
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Guard! Wh-what's happening? There was a white horse being chased and... I thought I saw Princess Zelda on it!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ちょっと兵士さん！ どうなってるの？私 見たんだよ追いかけられてた白い馬…その上で抱えられてたのは ゼルダ姫じゃないかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Wache! W-was passiert hier? Da war ein weißes Pferd, das verfolgt wurde... und ich glaube, ich habe Prinzessin Zelda darauf gesehen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_107
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: I saw it too! A Sheikah on a white horse! But why? ! Why would a Sheikah steal the princess away?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ワシも見たぞ！ 白馬に乗ったシーカー族を！あの冷静沈着なシーカー族が なりふり構わずゼルダ姫を連れ出すとは 一体何事じゃ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ich habe es auch gesehen! Eine Shiekah auf einem weißen Pferd!Aber warum? ! Warum sollte ausgerechnet eine Shiekah die Prinzessin entführen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_108
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: People, please! Try to remain calm.The princess...leaving with a Sheikah? I'm sure this is all just a big misunderstanding.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 大丈夫ですから どうか落ち着いて…姫様が し… シーカー族と姿を消すなんてみ… 見間違えですよ！ ははは… は…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Leute, bitte! Versucht, ruhig zu bleiben.Die Prinzessin... soll mit einer Shiekah verschwunden sein? Ich bin sicher, dass das alles nur ein großes Missverständnis ist.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_109
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hey, what're you doing here?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: うん？ なんだ いたのか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ach, was machst du denn hier?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: This is the town that sits under Hyrule Castle.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: さっきも言ったがここは ハイラル城の城下町である
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Das ist die Stadt unterhalb von Schloss Hyrule.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_110
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, it's you.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: うん？ なんだ キミか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, du bist’s.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_111
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Huh? Oh, it's just a child.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: うん？ なんだ 子供か…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Ach, ist ja bloß ein Kind.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_114
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Things have been pretty dangerous lately, so it'd be best if you hurried on home.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ここ最近 何かと物騒だからな早く お家に帰るんだよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Es ist ziemlich gefährlich hier in letzter Zeit, also geh am besten schnell nach Hause.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_115
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: It's late. Kids should be home at this hour.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: もういい時間なんだから子供は家で 大人しくしてなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Es ist spät. Kinder sollten um diese Zeit zu Hause sein.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_116
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Why are we just standing around? We have to go after Ganondorf and Princess Zelda...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: それにしても 別働隊は何をしているのだ…早くガノンドロフとゼルダ姫を 追わねば…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Warum stehen wir bloß herum? Wir müssen hinter Ganondorf und Prinzessin Zelda her...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: It's a pretty peaceful place. Been that way ever since our current king took the throne.If you're here for sightseeing, try to stay close to your parents, alright?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 今の王が即位されてからは大した争いも無い 平和な町だよ観光で来たのなら 親御さんと はぐれないようにな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ein ziemlich friedlicher Ort, seitdem unser jetziger König auf dem Thron sitzt.Falls du hier bist, um dir Sehenswürdigkeiten anzusehen, bleib nah bei deinen Eltern, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_122
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Don't leave town if you can help it.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: くれぐれも 町の外には出ないようにな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Verlass die Stadt nicht, wenn du nicht musst.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_126
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Oh, uh... It's nothing a kid should worry over. People in town are just confused, that's all.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ハハハ 子供が気にすることではない町のみんなも 何か勘違いしているだけだよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Oh, äh... Kinder müssen sich darüber keine Sorgen machen. Die Bewohner in der Stadt sind nur verwirrt, das ist alles.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_127
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Things are pretty dangerous right now, so it's best to stay inside.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 最近は 何かと物騒なんだからお家にいるのが 一番だ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Es ist momentan ziemlich gefährlich, daher ist es am besten, das Haus nicht zu verlassen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_128
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hey, kid... You really shouldn't be out this late.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ぼうず 子供がこんな時間に出歩いちゃダメだぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Hey, Kleiner... Du solltest so spät nicht mehr hier draußen sein.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: This town is usually pretty peaceful. But ever since that Ganondorf incident...not so much...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ガノンドロフの一件さえ無ければ平和な町だったのだが…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Diese Stadt ist normalerweise ziemlich friedlich. Aber seit diesem Ganondorf-Vorfall... nicht mehr so sehr...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Monsters come out at night, so make sure you're home before then.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 夜になったら 外は魔物が出るからそれまでには帰るんだぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Nachts tauchen hier Monster auf, also sieh zu, dass du zuvor zu Hause bist!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hope that helps. Now get home safe. Kids shouldn't be out and about at this hour.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: わかったな？でも 今日はもういい時間だから 早く帰りなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ich hoffe, das hilft. Jetzt geh lieber nach Hause. Um diese Zeit sollten Kinder nicht mehr draußen herumlaufen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Do you need something?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 何か困ったことが あるのかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Benötigst du etwas?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_20
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: You see that structure off in the distance, way up on that hill? That's Hyrule Castle.To get there, go straight past the fountain in the plaza and continue on. Take care not to get lost.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: あそこに見えるのが ハイラル城だよ噴水広場を抜けて まっすぐ進むだけだけど迷子にならないようにな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Siehst du das gewaltige Bauwerk da hinten auf dem Hügel? Das ist Schloss Hyrule.Du kannst es gar nicht verfehlen, wenn du am Brunnen auf dem Platz vorbei einfach geradeaus gehst. Aber verirr dich nicht dabei, hörst du?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_200
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Don't mess with grown-ups!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 大人をからかうんじゃない！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Leg dich nicht mit Erwachsenen an!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_201
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: You might be a child, but I have my limits! Don't push it, kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 子供だからって 限度があるぞイタズラは ほどほどにしておけよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ich versteh’s ja, du bist ein Kind. Aber es gibt Grenzen! Es reicht mit deinen Streichen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_202
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Hey! Kid!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: こらっ ぼうず！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Hey! Kleiner!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_203
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Don't you understand I'm telling you to stop? Cut it out!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: やめろといってるのが わからんのか！いい加減にしなさい！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Verstehst du nicht, dass ich dir sage, dass du aufhören sollst? Schluss damit!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Got all that? Great! Now, if you run into trouble, you can always ask an adult for help.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: わかったなら よし！困ったら いつでも大人を頼りなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Verstanden? Gut. Wenn du in Schwierigkeiten gerätst, kannst du jederzeit einen Erwachsenen um Hilfe bitten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_22
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: If you have any questions, you can always ask an adult for help.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: わからないことがあったらいつでも大人を頼りなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Wenn du Fragen hast, kannst du jederzeit einen Erwachsenen um Hilfe bitten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_23
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Take care, then.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: それでは 気をつけてな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Mach’s gut.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_24
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Farewell.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: では また
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Leb wohl.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_25
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Can I help you with something, kid?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: こんな時間にどうした？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Kann ich dir irgendwie helfen, Kleiner?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_26
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Still need directions to the castle? Or did you want me to tell you about town?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: またこの町の説明を聞きたいのか？ハイラル城へは行けたのか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Willst du den Weg zum Schloss wissen? Oder soll ich dir einfach ein bisschen was über die Stadt erzählen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_27
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Sure thing. I can explain it as many times as you need.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: いいぞ 何度でも説明してやろう
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Aber sicher. Ich kann es so oft erklären wie nötig.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_28
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Do you need directions to Hyrule Castle while I'm at it?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ついでに ハイラル城への行き方も教えてやろうか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Soll ich dir auch den Weg zu Schloss Hyrule erklären?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_29
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Did you want me to explain a bit about the town while I'm at it?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: ついでに この町のことも説明しようか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Möchtest du auch etwas über die Stadt hören?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_30
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Can I help you with something, kid?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: こんな時間にどうした？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Kann ich dir irgendwie helfen, Kleiner?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_39
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Remember to head back home before dark, OK?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: お家に帰るなら 明るいうちにな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Geh nach Hause, solange es noch hell ist, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_40
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Try not to worry your parents, alright?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 親御さんに 心配かけるんじゃないぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Mach deinen Eltern keine Sorgen, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_41
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Alright, but if you stay out too late, you might get eaten by a big, scary...moOoOonster!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: あんまり遅くまで遊んでると…大きくて… 毛だらけの… コワ～い魔物に…食われちゃうぞ～！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Also gut, aber wenn du zu lange draußen bleibst, könntest du gefressen werden... von einem großen, unheimlichen...Moooonster!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_42
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: You kids are always brimming with energy. I'm almost jealous...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 子供って 朝から元気でうらやましいよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ihr Kinder habt immer so viel Energie... Ich bin fast ein bisschen neidisch...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_43
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: I won't tell your parents I saw you out this late, but hurry home now.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 親御さんには ヒミツにしてあげるから早く帰りなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Ich werde es deinen Eltern vorerst nicht verraten, aber geh schnell nach Hause.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_44
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Heh... Just kidding!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: …なーんてね！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Hihi... War nur Spaß!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_45
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Well? Scared enough to run along home now?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: どう？ 帰りたくなったか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Na? Hast du jetzt einen solchen Schreck gekriegt, dass du brav nach Hause gehst?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_46
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: You've got so much energy this morning. Wish you could share some of that with me...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 朝早くから元気だね…オジさんにも その体力分けてほしいよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Du hast so viel Energie heute Morgen. Kannst du mir nicht ein bisschen was abgeben?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.Label: Talk_47
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.USenText: Go home before your parents get upset.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.JPjaText: 親御さんに怒られないうちに早く帰るんだぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_008_Child.EUdeText: Geh nach Hause, bevor deine Eltern wütend werden.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: I'll pay...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 払う
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Ich zahle...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: No deal!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 払わない
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Lieber nicht.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: What happened?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 何があったの？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Was ist passiert?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Bye.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: バイバイ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Wiedersehen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Princess Zelda?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ゼルダ姫って？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Prinzessin Zelda?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: No.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 違います
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Nein.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: GlassTruth
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Yes, yes, nice goggles.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい すごいメガネだねー
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Ja, ja, tolle Brille.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Ah yes. Mr. Keaton, always a pleasure.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい キータンさん こんにちは
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Ah ja. Wie immer eine Freude, Herr Keaton.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Well, aren't you a big scary monster.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい 怖い怖い 魔物さんのお面だねー
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Na, du großes, furchterregendes Monster.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Yes, yes, very scary.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい 怖い怖い 怖いお面だねー
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Ja, ja, sehr unheimlich.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Mr. Bunny, welcome.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい ウサギさん いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Willkommen, Herr Hase.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: *sigh* I could really go for some Lon Lon milk.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ハァ… ロンロン牛乳でも飲みながら 休憩したいぜ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hach, etwas Lon-Lon-Milch wär jetzt was Feines.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_05_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: What's with this kid?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: …なんだ？ この小僧
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Was ist mit diesem Jungen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_05_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Some soldier... I'm nowhere close to Ganondorf... I'm sorry, Princess... Please be OK.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ガノンドロフ 触ることすらできなかったゼルダ姫は大丈夫かな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Was bin ich bloß für ein Soldat... Ich konnte Ganondorf nicht aufhalten! Tut mir leid, Prinzessin... Ich hoffe, es geht ihr gut.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Welcome, Mr. Goron.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい ゴロンさん いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Willkommen, Herr Gorone.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Mr. Zora, welcome.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい ゾーラさん いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Willkommen, Herr Zora.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Ah, a mini Gerudo, welcome.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい ゲルドさん いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Ah, ein Mini-Gerudo. Willkommen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_08_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: A Gerudo Mask? You know, if you were truly a Gerudo, I'd throw you in jail.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ゲルドのお面とは 不謹慎な…本物なら 牢屋にぶち込むところだぞ
