EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Eine Gerudo-Maske? Wie... unangebracht. Wenn du wirklich ein Gerudo wärst, würde ich dich festnehmen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: So...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ってか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Also...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Whoa... What's that?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: うわっとと… なんだよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hey... Was ist das?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Huh? ! Princess Zelda? ! Wait, no... Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Welcome in.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: あれっ！？ ゼルダ姫！？なんだ違うか… いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Na, so was! Prinzessin Zelda? !Aber nein... Entschuldigung, ich dachte, du wärst jemand anders.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Welcome, young man.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい お坊ちゃん いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Willkommen, junger Herr.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Mask_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Welcome, traveler.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: はいはい おのぼりさん いらっしゃい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Willkommen, Reisender.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Oh, let me guess. You thought you'd just waltz on by and meet Princess Zelda, did you?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: さてはオマエもゼルダ姫の評判を 聞いて来たんだな？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Lass mich raten. Du dachtest, du kannst hier einfach vorbeischneien und Prinzessin Zelda treffen, oder?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Huh... You really want to get through the gate, don't you? Fine, I'll let you in. But in return...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: …なんだ？どうしても この門を 通りたいのか？なら 通してやらんこともないその代わり…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hmm... Du willst unbedingt durch das Tor gehen, nicht wahr? Na gut, ich lass dich rein. Aber dafür will ich...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: I think 10 rupees sounds fair to me. What do you say?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 10ルピー 払いな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Für mich klingen 10 Rubine fair. Was meinst du?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Trust me, kid, there's no way the princess wants to meet you, especially not now.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: こんな時間に姫様が お会いになるワケが無かろう
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Glaub mir, Kleiner, die Prinzessin wird dich bestimmt nicht treffen wollen, insbesondere jetzt nicht.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Fine. It's probably more than you can afford, anyway. Go home, kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ま 子供にゃ ムリな金額かもなほら 帰った 帰った！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Gut. Ist wahrscheinlich eh mehr, als du dir leisten kannst. Geh nach Hause, Kleiner.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Hah! Pleasure doing business with you.Alright, head on through. But if anyone asks, you got in on your own, got it?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 話がわかる奴だなよし こっそり通してやるこっそりとな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Schön, mit dir Geschäfte zu machen.Also gut, dann geh durch. Aber wenn dich jemand fragt, sagst du, dass du ganz alleine reingekommen bist, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: It's a secret to everybody.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ミンナニ ナイショダヨ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Das bleibt aber unter uns.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: What? You don't have enough money?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: なんだ 足りないじゃないか！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Was? Du hast nicht genug Rubine?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: You're back again? Geez, you never give up...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: また来たのか？あきらめが 悪い奴だ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Du schon wieder? Meine Güte, du gibst wohl nie auf...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Go on. Shoo!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: ほら 帰った帰った
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Geh weg. Husch!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_100
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Hey! Know your place!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 大人をからかうんじゃない！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hey! Leg dich nicht mit mir an!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: You might be a child, but I have my limits! Don't push it, kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 子供だからって 限度があるぞイタズラは ほどほどにしておけよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Auch wenn du noch ein Kind bist, gibt es Grenzen! Spiel deine Streiche jemand anderem!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: What the— HEY!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: こらっ 小僧！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Was zum... HEY!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Didn't I already tell you to cut it out? Stop it or else!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: やめろといってるのが わからんのか！いい加減にしなさい！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hab ich dir nicht gesagt, du solltest damit aufhören? ! Lass das, sonst gibt’s Ärger!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Like I said, if you want to get through, it'll cost you 10 rupees—take it or leave it.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: さっきも言ったが 通りたいなら 10ルピーだ1ルピーも まからないぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Wie ich schon sagte, wenn du hier durch willst, kostet dich das 10 Rubine. Zahl’s oder geh.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: The castle is currently on high alert! We aren't letting so much as a puppy in or out!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 今 城内は 厳重警戒中だ！たとえ犬一匹でも 城へは通さん！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Das Schloss befindet sich gerade in höchster Alarmbereitschaft! Wir lassen nicht mal ein Hündchen rein oder raus!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Now scram, before you waste more of my time.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 時間の無駄だ 帰れ帰れ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Verschwinde jetzt, bevor du meine Zeit noch weiter verschwendest.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Back again, huh?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 小僧 まだちょろちょろしていたのか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Wieder da, was?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Look at yourself, kid. I don't think the princess would bother with you...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 姫様が オマエのような子供にお会いになるワケがないだろ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Sieh dich doch mal an, Kleiner. Ich bezweifle, dass die Prinzessin sich um dich scheren würde...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_17
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: What's the matter, kid?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: なんだ小僧？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Was ist los, Kleiner?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_18
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Kid, do you have any idea what time it is? What could you possibly need at this hour?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: こんな夜分に… 子供がなんの用だ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hast du eine Idee, wie spät es ist, Kleiner? Was um alles in der Welt könntest du um diese Zeit wollen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_20
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: There it is—one open gate.Good luck making it past everyone inside. Heh... You'll need it.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 門ならこの通りだせいぜい 中の奴らに見つからないように 進むことだな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Da, ein offenes Tor.Viel Glück dabei, es an allen da drinnen vorbeizuschaffen. Hehe... Du wirst es brauchen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Well, the gate's open. Can't promise you'll meet the princess though.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 門なら開けてるぜそれでも姫様に会える保証は 無いけどな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Nun, das Tor ist offen. Kann dir aber nicht versprechen, dass du die Prinzessin treffen wirst.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_22
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Aren't you the kid from before?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: あの時の小僧か…？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Bist du nicht der Kleine von vorhin?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_24
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: I've been instructed not to speak on the situation inside the castle.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 城内で起こったことは 口外しないよう上の者から クギを刺されている
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Ich habe die Anweisung, mit niemandem über die Lage im Schloss zu sprechen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_25
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Don't worry about it, kid. It's grown-up business.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 子供に話すようなことは 何も無いぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Mach dir keine Gedanken darüber, Kleiner. Das ist eine Angelegenheit für Erwachsene.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_26
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Hey, boy... I thought I told you to go home.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 小僧… 帰れと言ったはずだが？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hey, Kleiner... Ich hatte dir doch gesagt, dass du nach Hause gehen sollst.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_27
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Attaboy. And you better not be causing any extra trouble either.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: …ったくこれ以上 仕事を増やさないでほしいぜ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Brav. Und wehe, du machst noch mehr Ärger.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_28
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Now go home. Shoo!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: わかったら 帰った 帰った！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Jetzt geh heim. Husch!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_29
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: I opened the gate last time, but I can't do that again.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: あの時は門を開いたが今回は そういうわけにはいかん
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Letztes Mal habe ich das Tor geöffnet, aber das kann ich nicht noch mal tun.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_30
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Go on, beat it, already.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: わかったら さっさと帰れ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Na los, hau endlich ab.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_31
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Surely you've at least heard of her. She's the princess of Hyrule, of course.She's incredibly wise. And she sees prophecies in her dreams that actually come true! But what am I telling a kid like you for?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: この城の姫様に決まってるだろう『夢で見たお告げが現実になる』というそれはそれは すごいお方なのだまぁ オマエのような小僧には関係の無いこった
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Du hast sicherlich schon mal von ihr gehört. Sie ist natürlich die Prinzessin von Hyrule.Sie ist unglaublich weise. Und sie kann in ihren Träumen tatsächlich die Zukunft vorhersehen.Aber warum erzähle ich das einem Kind wie dir?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_32
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: No? Well, alright then.Either way, I can't let some random kid inside.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: フン… そうかまぁ どっちにしても オマエのような小僧を城に入れるワケにはいかん
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Nicht? Na gut, dann eben nicht.Wie dem auch sei, ich kann nicht einfach ein dahergelaufenes Kind reinlassen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_33
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Now, run along.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: わかったら ほら 帰った帰った
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Also verschwinde jetzt.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_34
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: What now? Just admit it, kid. You came to meet Princess Zelda, didn't you?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: しつこいぞ小僧 やっぱりオマエゼルダ姫の評判を 聞いて来たんだろ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Also... Gib es doch einfach zu, Kleiner. Du bist hier, um Prinzessin Zelda zu treffen, oder?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_35
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Then go home and quit bothering me. Can't you see I'm busy doing soldier stuff?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: だったら 帰った帰ったオレは忙しいんだから もう邪魔するなよ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Dann geh nach Hause und lass mich in Ruhe. Siehst du nicht, dass ich mit Soldatenarbeit beschäftigt bin?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_36
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Go on. Shoo!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: さぁ 帰った帰った
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Na los. Husch!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_37
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: And about the deal we made...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: オレがオマエを通したこと…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Und dass ich dich durchgelassen habe...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_38
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: The castle is still on lockdown. No one's allowed in or out!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 城内は 未だ厳重警戒中だ！たとえ犬一匹でも 城へは通さん！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Das Schloss ist immer noch abgeriegelt. Niemand darf rein oder raus.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_40
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Kids shouldn't hang around the gate. Go home.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 門ならこの通りだとはいえ 子供は家に帰る時間だぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Kinder sollten nicht vorm Tor herumhängen. Geh heim.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_41
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Gate's open, but it's dark, so try not to trip on your way.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 門なら開けてるぜ暗くなっているから 転ばないよう気をつけろよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Das Tor ist offen. So dunkel, wie es ist, musst du aber gut aufpassen, dass du auf dem Weg nicht stolperst.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.Label: Talk_42
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.USenText: Get lost. Shoo!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.JPjaText: 帰れ 帰れ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_009_Child.EUdeText: Hau ab. Husch!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Near_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: What's going on?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: なんだ…？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Was geht da vor?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Near_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Something moved...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 何か動いたような…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Hat sich da was bewegt?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Near_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: What was that? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 気配がするぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Was war das? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Hold it right there!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: オイ 止まれ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Bleib genau da stehen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Who's there? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 誰だっ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Wer ist da? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Freeze, scoundrel!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 動くな！ 曲者め！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Bleib stehen, Schurke!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Hey! You, in the mask! You're out of here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 待て！ そこのお面小僧！連行する！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Hey! Du da mit der Maske! Raus mit dir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: You, with the mask! What do you think you're doing? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: お面のお前！ そこで何をしている！こっちに来い！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Du da mit der Maske! Was machst du da? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: You, in the mask! Don't move!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: そこのお面！ 動くな！つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Du da in der Maske! Stillgestanden!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Guh! Freeze!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: むっ！ 怪しい奴め 連行する！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: He! Bleib stehen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: A villain? At this hour? ! Come over here—NOW!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: こんな時間に誰だっ！こっちに来い！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Ein Bösewicht? Um diese Zeit? ! Komm sofort her!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: You there! Sneaking around, are you? Well, fun's over!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 誰だっ！ コソコソしやがって…つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Du da! Schleichst dich hier einfach herum, was? Der Spaß hat jetzt ein Ende!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Skulking around the castle, huh? Not on my watch!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: コソコソしやがって… つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Was schleichst du dich hier herum? Nicht mit mir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: How'd you get in? ! Come here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: どこから入った！？ こっちに来い！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Wie bist du hier reingekommen? ! Komm sofort her!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Got you! You're out of here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 怪しい奴め！ 連行する！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Hab dich! Und jetzt raus mit dir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: That silly mask doesn't scare me, kid. Scram!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: ふざけたお面 被りやがって…つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Diese alberne Maske macht mir keine Angst, Kleiner. Raus mit dir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_17
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Hiding your face, huh? You're coming with me!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: お面なんかして 怪しい奴め…連行する！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Du versuchst, dein Gesicht zu verbergen... Du kommst mit mir mit!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_18
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: That mask... Do I look like a joke to you? Come here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 馬鹿にしてるのか？ そのお面…こっちに来い！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Diese Maske... Willst du dich über mich lustig machen? Komm her!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_19
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: What a ridiculous hood! You're done!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: ふざけたずきん 被りやがって…つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Du, mit dieser lächerlichen Kopfbedeckung! Du bist erledigt!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_20
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Made it pretty far with that on your head. But this is as far as you go!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: そんな頭で よくここまで来れたな！たたき出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Bist ganz schön weit gekommen mit dem Ding auf deinem Kopf. Aber hier ist jetzt Schluss!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Look at you, with a silly thing on your head. Come here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: ナメた頭 しやがって…こっちに来い！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Sieh dich mal an mit diesem albernen Ding auf deinem Kopf. Komm her!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_22
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: HEY! I see you sneaking around over there! Come with me!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 誰だ！ コソコソしやがって… つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Hey! Ich sehe, wie du dich hier herumschleichst! Komm her zu mir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_23
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: What the... How did you get in? ! Come with me!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: 小僧！ どこから入った！？ こっちに来い！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Was zum... Wie bist du hier reingekommen? ! Komm sofort her!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_24
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Hey, what do you think you're doing? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: お前！ そこで何をしている！たたき出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Hey, was machst du denn da?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_25
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Huh? Princess? ! Hold on! Pretending to be the princess, eh? ! Not on my watch!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: あれ？ 姫………？紛らわしいかっこう するんじゃない！つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Prinzessin? !Warte mal... Du tust nur so, als wärst du die Prinzessin! Aber nicht mit mir!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_26
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Huh? Princess Zelda...Wait a second... You're not the princess! Get out of here, kid!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: あれ！？ ゼルダ姫！？………違うじゃないか！不審者め つまみ出してやる！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Nanu? Prinzessin Zelda...Moment mal... Du bist gar nicht die Prinzessin! Mach, dass du hier wegkommst, Kleiner!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: Talk_27
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Oh! Princess Zelda! Huh? Is that a mask? ! Don't mess with me, kid! Leave now!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: あっ 姫！…あれ？ お面！？ふざけるな！ たたき出してやる！！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Oh! Prinzessin Zelda!Hä? Eine Maske? ! Versuch ja nicht, mich zu veralbern, Kleiner!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: TerrorSword_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: What? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: なんだ！？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Was? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: TerrorSword_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Huh?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: なっ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Hä?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.Label: TerrorSword_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.USenText: Whoa!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.JPjaText: うわっ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_010_Child.EUdeText: Aaaah!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Yes...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: そうなんです…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Ja...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: I'm not lost!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: 迷子じゃない！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Nein, nicht verirrt!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Balloon_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Hm?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Hm?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Oh! Is that a Keaton Mask? Heh! You're like a mini Keaton.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: む！ そのお面は キータンだな？小さなキータンだな ふふっ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Oh! Ist das eine Keaton-Maske? Ha! Du siehst aus wie ein Mini-Keaton.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Ha! Is that a monster mask? Guess that makes you a mini monster.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: む！ そのお面は魔物かな？小さな魔物だな ふふっ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Ha! Ist das eine Monstermaske? Ich schätze, das macht dich zu einem Minimonster.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Haha! Was that mask supposed to surprise me? Nice try, kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: ふふっ そんなお面で 驚くとでも思ったかちびっ子よ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Haha! Sollte mich diese Maske überraschen? Netter Versuch, Kleiner.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: That hood really stands out, you know...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: そのずきん すごく目立ってるぞちびっ子よ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Diese Kopfbedeckung fällt wirklich auf, Kleiner...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: If the king and Zelda aren't around, who's going to pay me...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: ハイラル王もゼルダ姫も おられないなら給料は 誰が払ってくれるんだろう…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Wenn der König und Zelda nicht da sind, wer zahlt mir dann meinen Lohn...?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Oh! Cool Goron Mask! But I thought they were usually a lot bigger. Haha.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: む！ そのお面はゴロン族かな？小さなゴロン族だな ふふっ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Oh! Tolle Goronenmaske! Aber ich hätte gedacht, dass die viel größer sind. Haha.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Oh? Is that a Zora Mask? Heheh! I thought the Zora were typically taller.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: む！ そのお面はゾーラ族かな？小さなゾーラ族だな ふふっ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Oh? Ist das eine Zora-Maske? Hihi! Ich dachte, die Zoras wären viel größer.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Whoa! That's a Gerudo Mask, right? Heh! Never seen a Gerudo this small.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: む！ そのお面はゲルド族かな？小さなゲルド族だな ふふっ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Wow! Das ist eine Gerudo-Maske, oder? Ich habe noch nie so eine kleine Gerudo gesehen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Umm...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Ähm...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Whoa! You surprised me...I was lost in thought, I guess... Anyways... Yeah.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: わ！ びっくりした…ちょっと考え事をしてたからさ…それはともかくとして… だ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Uff! Du hast mich erschreckt...Ich war wohl ganz in Gedanken verloren... Wie dem auch sei...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Huh? Is that a mask of Princess Zelda? I suppose you two are about the same height...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: む！ そのお面はゼルダ姫かな？背格好までよく似ているな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Ist das eine Prinzessin-Zelda-Maske? Hm, ich schätze, ihr seid in etwa gleich groß.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Why is a boy wearing a mask of...a boy?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: 少年が 少年のお面を被っているとは何か 事情があるのかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Warum trägt ein Junge die Maske eines... Jungen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Mask_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: That's a pretty strange mask, kid.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: なんとも言い難いお面だなちびっ子よ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Das ist eine ziemlich seltsame Maske, Kleiner.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: You sure? Because if you're not lost, that must make you a trespasser.Nah, that couldn't be it... Look, just go home, alright?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: 「迷子じゃない」だと？だったら不審者か？そんなわけないか…わかったら とっとと帰りなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Bist du sicher? Denn wenn du dich nicht verirrt hast, bist du ein Eindringling.Nein, das kann nicht sein... Hör mal, geh einfach nach Hause, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: What's wrong? Are you lost?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: どうして こんなところにいるんだ？もしかして迷子か？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Was ist los? Hast du dich verirrt?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: I see... Well, I'd help you, but I can't just leave my post.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: そうか… 参ったな俺は ここを 離れられないし…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Verstehe... Ich würde dir ja gern helfen, aber ich kann nicht einfach meinen Posten verlassen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Hey! Anyone! I have a lost child here that needs an escort out!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: おーい！ 誰か！この子を 外まで送ってやってくれないか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Hey! Irgendjemand! Ich habe hier ein verirrtes Kind, das jemand nach draußen begleiten muss!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Come on, kid, can't you just retrace your steps? I still can't leave this spot.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: まったく… 来た道ぐらい覚えててくれ俺は ここを 離れられないんだってば…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Komm schon, Kleiner. Kannst du nicht einfach deine Schritte zurückverfolgen? Ich kann meinen Posten immer noch nicht verlassen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Hey, aren't you the boy from before? What's going on with the garden's security...Are you really lost this time?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: この前の少年じゃないか庭の警備はどうなっているんだ…今度こそ 迷子になったのかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Hey Junge, warst du nicht schon mal hier? Was ist denn mit den Bewachern vom Garten los...Hast du dich diesmal wirklich verirrt?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: What's wrong? Think you're lost after all?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: どうした？ 少年やっぱり 迷子だったのか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Was ist los? Hast du dich doch verirrt?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Alright, calm down—it was just a question. If you're not lost, hurry up and go home.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: わかったから デカい声出すなって…迷子じゃないなら 早く帰りなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Ist ja schon gut, es war ja nur eine Frage. Wenn du dich nicht verirrt hast, beeil dich und lauf nach Hause.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: You again...Wow, security is so lax today...What is it? Are you still lost?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: また お前か…警備 ガバガバじゃねぇか…で どうした？また 迷ったのか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Du schon wieder...Die Wachen sind so unaufmerksam...Was ist los? Hast du dich wieder verlaufen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: OK, OK! Your parents are probably worried sick about you, so why don't you go home.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: わかったわかった！親御さんも心配しているだろうから 早く帰るんだぞ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: In Ordnung! Deine Eltern sind bestimmt schon krank vor Sorge um dich, also geh doch einfach nach Hause.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.USenText: Level with me, kid. You're lost, right? You can tell me the truth.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.JPjaText: 少年よ 迷子なんだろ？ 正直に言いなさい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_027_Child.EUdeText: Sei ehrlich zu mir. Du hast dich verirrt, oder? Du kannst mir die Wahrheit sagen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Ghost research?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オバケって？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Geister?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: What did you say?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 今 なんて？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Wie bitte?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Tell me about it!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 聞きたい
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ich will mehr hören!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: I should get going...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: さようなら
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ich sollte gehen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: GlassTruth
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Wow! Cool goggles! I wonder if you can see ghosts with them.Just kidding! Hee hee!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: おお！ すごいメガネ！それを掛ければ オバケが見えるのかな！？なーんてね！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Oha! Tolle Brille! Kannst du damit Geister sehen? War nur Spaß! Hihi!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Really—a mask? Sorry, but that's a bit childish, don't you think?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: …変なお面だねそういう幼稚なモノには 興味無いかな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ernsthaft? Eine Maske? Entschuldige, aber das ist ein bisschen kindisch, findest du nicht?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: What a lovely mask! It's inspiring.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: イカしたお面だねぇ！その雰囲気 好きだよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Was für eine schöne Maske! Sehr inspirierend.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: What a creepy little mask! I love it.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 不気味なお面だねぇ！その雰囲気 好きだよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Was für eine unheimliche Maske! Ich finde sie großartig.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: What's that, some fancy hood? It's a bit too cheery, if you ask me.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: なんだい？ そのファンシーなずきんは…そういう陽気なの 苦手だ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Was ist das denn für eine schicke Kopfbedeckung? Die ist mir ein bisschen zu fröhlich.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Once I'm off duty, I can go collect more ghost souls! I should remember to bring an empty bottle this time...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 非番になったら オバケの魂を採取しに行こうっと！あきビンを 忘れないようにしなきゃ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Sobald ich Feierabend habe, kann ich weitere Geisterseelen sammeln! Ich sollte daran denken, diesmal eine leere Flasche mitzunehmen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_05_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Oh! What a cool mask! I wish my face looked like that!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: おお！ かっこいいお面！オイラの目指すべきは こういう顔だよ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Oh! Was für eine tolle Maske! Ich wünschte, mein Gesicht würde so aussehen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: That mask... It's so...uninteresting.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: なんだい？ その丸っこいお面は興味無いかな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Diese Maske... ist so... uninteressant.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Oh... A Zora Mask... It looks terrifying at night.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: おお… ゾーラ族のお面か…夜見るとコワイな…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Oh... Eine Zora-Maske... Nachts sieht die total unheimlich aus.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: That's a thief's mask. In a way, it's scarier than a ghost... Hee hee.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 盗賊のお面だねある意味 オバケより怖いよね… ヒヒッ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Diese Maske soll eine Räuberin darstellen. Auf gewisse Weise ist die gruseliger als ein Geist... Hihi.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Hm? That mask almost looks like Princess Zelda.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: あれ？ そのお面 ゼルダ姫に似てるねぇちょっと雰囲気 違うけど…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Nanu? Diese Maske sieht ja fast aus wie Prinzessin Zelda.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Wait... Is that mask... Hmm. Never mind...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: あれ？ そのお面 ひょっとして…いや なんでもないよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Warte mal... Ist diese Maske... Hmm. Ach, egal...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Mask_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Huh? Is that mask from another world? Can I have a closer look?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: あれ？ そのお面 この世の物かい？その雰囲気 好きだよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Huch? Ist diese Maske aus einer anderen Welt? Kann ich mir die mal näher ansehen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Near_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: *mumble*
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: ボソボソ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hmhmmm...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Near_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: *mumble* *mumble*

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hrmbl...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Near_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Back to work...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: さ 仕事仕事…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Zurück an die Arbeit...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Near_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: I'm leaving early...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 早く帰ろう…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ich mach früher Schluss...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Being on watch is a complete waste of time...Why spend my time here when I could be researching ghosts?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: …見張り番なんて 時間の無駄だこんな時間が あるんだったら早く帰って オバケの研究をしたい…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Wache zu halten ist reine Zeitverschwendung...Warum sollte ich meine Zeit hier verbringen, wenn ich Geister erforschen könnte?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Ah! Oh no, you heard that, didn't you? Well, nothing I can do about it now. Listen close, and I'll let you in on something fascinating...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: あっ… ボウヤ 聞いてたの…？聞かれてたなら しょうがないな… 少しだけ教えてあげるよ トクベツに…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ah! Oh nein, du hast das gehört, oder? Nun, das kann ich jetzt auch nicht mehr ändern. Hör gut zu, dann erzähle ich dir etwas Faszinierendes...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Oh... Uh... Nothing, kid. Really, it's nothing. Just forget it, OK?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: あっ… ボウヤ…別に… なんでも… ない… よ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Oh... Ähm... Ach nichts, Kleiner. Wirklich, es ist gar nichts. Vergiss es einfach, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Please keep my research a secret, OK?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オバケの研究のことはナイショにしといてくれよな
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Erzähl niemandem von meiner Forschung, ja?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Hee hee! Beautiful night, eh, kid? I'm so excited I can hardly hold still! Soon— Yes! Very soon, and my ghost research will finally be complete.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: やあ ボウヤ…今日はいい夜だね… ヒヒヒ…オイラ 今… ワクワクしてるんだ…なんたって もうすぐオバケの研究が完成しそうだからね…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hihi! Eine schöne Nacht heute, nicht wahr, Kleiner? Ich bin so aufgeregt, dass ich kaum stillhalten kann!Bald... Ja! Bald wird meine Geisterforschung abgeschlossen sein.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Hee hee... May tonight be beautiful... Hee hee...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: ヒヒ… お互い イイ夜を…ヒヒ… ヒヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hihi... Auf dass heute Nacht wundervoll wird... Hihi...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_100
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: They've got me guarding the cramped little storeroom.*sigh* I have far more important things to do...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オイラこれから 物置の見張り番なんだ他にやりたいことが あるんだけどね…はぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Sie lassen mich den winzigen Lagerraum bewachen.Seufz... Dabei habe ich weitaus wichtigere Dinge zu erledigen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_101
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Stuck guarding the storeroom... My research doesn't have time for this.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: はぁ… 物置の見張りか…そんなことしてるヒマ 無いんだけどなぁ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Muss den Lagerraum bewachen... Meine Forschungen können doch nicht warten.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Work... What a nuisance...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: はぁ… 仕事が… ダルい…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Arbeit... was für eine Plage...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: My shift is finally over... I'll continue my research back at the castle.Oops! Hee hee... Did I say that out loud?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: やっと交代の時間だ…お城に戻ったら 研究を進めようおっと 独り言が過ぎたね…ヒヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Meine Schicht ist endlich vorbei... Ich werde weiter im Schloss an meinen Forschungen arbeiten.Ups! Hehe... Habe ich das etwa laut gesagt?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_104
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: I need to hurry back to the castle and continue my research...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 早くお城に戻って 研究の続きを… ヒヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ich muss schnell zurück zum Schloss und weiter an meinen Forschungen arbeiten...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Oh, but of course! Allow me to elaborate...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オイラのオバケの研究 気になるだろ？ 少しだけ教えてやろう
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ja, richtig gehört! Lass mich das genauer erläutern...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Well, according to my studies, when a ghost is destroyed, its soul stays behind with us...I wonder... What would happen if someone were to collect these souls, hm?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オイラの研究によると オバケをやっつけたら魂だけが残るんだその魂をたくさん集めたら どうなるか…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Nun, meinen Studien zufolge bleibt die Seele eines vernichteten Geistes bei uns zurück...Ich frage mich... Was würde wohl passieren, wenn jemand diese Seelen sammeln würde?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Bored? Perhaps you'd love to hear more about my ghost research.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: ボウヤもヒマだねぇ…またオバケの研究について 聞きたいのかい？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Gelangweilt? Vielleicht würdest du gern etwas mehr über meine Geisterforschungen hören?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Hee hee... You're curious about my ghost research, aren't you?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: ヒヒ… オバケの研究が気になるんだろ？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hihi... Du interessierst dich für meine Geisterforschungen, nicht wahr?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: First, tell me... Have you ever seen a ghost for yourself? They're spooky, floaty things!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: ボウヤは オバケを見たことあるかい？ふわふわ浮いてる 不気味な奴らさ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Aber verrate mir zuerst... Hast du selbst schon einmal einen Geist gesehen? Das sind gruselige, schwebende Dinger!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: No? Very well. Hee hee...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: はい さよなら… ヒヒッ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Nein? Na gut. Hihi...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_19
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Perhaps I'll tell you when you're older. Hee hee!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: それは キミが大人になったら教えてあげるよ ヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Vielleicht erzähle ich dir das, wenn du älter bist. Hihi...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_20
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Maybe that's a secret just for adults. Hehe...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: それは 大人だけの秘密さ…ヒヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Vielleicht ist das ein Geheimnis für Erwachsene. Hihi...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_200
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Here I am, stuck guarding the storeroom...But it's probably safer here than in the castle. Perhaps I can use this time to hypothesize...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オイラこれから 物置の見張り番なんだ今は城より 安全だろうしじっくり 考え事ができそうだ… ヒヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Da häng ich hier fest, weil ich den Lagerraum bewachen muss...Aber es ist wahrscheinlich sicherer hier als im Schloss. Vielleicht kann ich die Zeit nutzen, um Theorien aufzustellen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_201
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Time to go to "work." Hee hee...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: さて 仕事仕事… ヒヒヒ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Zeit, zur „Arbeit“ zu gehen. Hihi...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_202
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Time to daydream at the usual place...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 今日もいつもの場所で妄想にふけらせてもらうとするよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Zeit zum Tagträumen... äh, ich meine natürlich „arbeiten“. Hihi...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_203
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: *sigh* Shift change...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: はあ… もう交代の時間か
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Seufz... Wachwechsel...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_204
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: *sigh* They'll be expecting me at the castle...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: はあ… 城に戻らないと…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Seufz... Man erwartet mich im Schloss...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_205
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Thanks to what happened, I can hardly hear myself think at the castle anymore. I must finish my research quickly.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: あの一件のせいで 城に戻っても気が休まらないんだよな早く オバケの研究を進めたいのに…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Nach dem, was passiert ist, kann ich im Schloss kaum noch klar denken. Ich muss meine Forschungen schnell beenden.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_206
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: All anyone cares about is "Princess Zelda this" and "Princess Zelda that." It's so distracting...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 城に戻っても ゼルダ様の話でもちきりなんだよな…気が散って 研究に集中できないよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Alle interessieren sich nur noch für Prinzessin Zelda dies und Prinzessin Zelda das. Ich kann mich so nicht konzentrieren...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: H-hey! You're distracting me!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: コッ… コラ！ 気が散るじゃないか！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: H-hey! Du lenkst mich ab!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_22
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: I know you kids like to pull pranks, but you shouldn't disturb people while they're working...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: イタズラしたい お年頃なんだろうけど働いている人の 邪魔しちゃいけないよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ich weiß, dass ihr Kinder gern Streiche spielt, aber ihr solltet Leute nicht bei der Arbeit stören...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_23
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: C-come on!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: かっ… 勘弁してくれ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: G-geh weg!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: Talk_24
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: I told you to leave me alone! If you're going to play, do it somewhere else!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: オイラに構うな って言っただろ！遊ぶなら よそにしてくれ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ich hab dir gesagt, dass du mich in Ruhe lassen sollst! Wenn du spielen willst, tu das gefälligst woanders!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: TerrorArrow_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: What are you doing? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: 何すんだ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Was machst du da? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: TerrorArrow_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Stop it!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: やめなって
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hör auf damit!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: TerrorArrow_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Really? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: マジ！？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Wirklich? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: TerrorSword_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: What the—
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: なんだ！？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Was zum? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: TerrorSword_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Hey!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: おい！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Hey!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.Label: TerrorSword_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.USenText: Seriously? !
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.JPjaText: マジ！？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Soldier_029_Child.EUdeText: Ernsthaft? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: Act_Farmear_Terror_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: Hey, knock it off!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: やめるだーよ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.EUdeText: Was soll das denn?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: Act_Farmear_Terror_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: I'm tryin' to work here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: 作業中は危ないだーよ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.EUdeText: Ich versuche zu arbeiten!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: Act_Farmear_Terror_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: What're you doin'?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: 何するだーよ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.EUdeText: Muss das denn sein? !

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: GlassTruth
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: Whoa. Those are some swanky specs... If I wore those around while I was trying to work, they'd get caught up on something for sure.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: わぁ 派手なメガネ…それつけてたら 作業の邪魔になるだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.EUdeText: Ui. Das nenn ich eine schicke Brille... Aber wenn ich die bei der Arbeit tragen würde, würde ich sicher an irgendwas damit hängenbleiben.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: Mask_00
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: Malon deserves only the best... I hope she ends up with someone good, like that boy from the forest.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: マロンのムコにはあの妖精ぼうやのような子が いいだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.EUdeText: Malon verdient nur das Beste... Ich hoffe, dass sie einen anständigen jungen Mann findet, so wie den aus dem Wald.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: Mask_01
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: Hey, I recognize that fella... I think Malon used to talk about him back in the day.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: そのお面 知ってるだーよ昔 マロンが話してただーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.EUdeText: Sag mal, den kenne ich doch... Mir ist, als hätte Malon immer von ihm erzählt. Wobei das schon etwas länger her sein mag.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.Label: Mask_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.USenText: Honey? ! You're looking a bit bony! ...Oh, it's just a mask.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult.csv.JPjaText: かーちゃん！？ 痩せすぎだーよ！………なんだ お面だーよ

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_102
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Huh? You went to Ingo Ran— Er, you went to Lon Lon Ranch? You talked to Ingo? Phew... I'm glad Malon is safe. I owe ya, son! I'm gonna turn over a new leaf and start busting my hump proper around the ranch again! And...that starts with gettin' outta here! I can't just be loafin' around here! I got ranchin' to do!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: え！ にいさん インゴー牧じょ…ロンロン牧場で インゴーと話をつけてきただか？ああ… マロンが無事で よかっただーよにいさん… ありがとだーよ！今度から 心入れ替えてマジメに しっかり お仕事するだーよ！こ… こーしちゃいられないだーよ！早く牧場に帰らないと！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Wie? Du bist zur Basil-Farm-- äh, zur Lon-Lon-Farm gegangen? Du hast mit Basil gesprochen? Puh... Ich bin ja so froh, dass es Malon gut geht. Ich schulde dir was, junger Mann!Und jetzt ist Schluss mit Trübsal blasen. Nun werde ich mich auf der Farm wieder so richtig reinhängen, das gelobe ich!Und... Zuallererst werde ich Kakariko verlassen! Was bringt mir sinnloses Rumlungern! Es gibt Farmarbeit zu erledigen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_103
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Phew! That cucco's crow really does the trick...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: コッコの鳴き声なかなか効いただーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Hui! So ein Huhn ist wirklich nicht zu überhören...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_104
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Hey, thanks for wakin' me up.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: 起こしてくれて ありがとだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Danke dafür, dass du mich aufgeweckt hast.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_105
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Lon Lon Ranch was taken over by this fella by the name of Ingo. Now it's called Ingo Ranch.Ingo kicked me out, which landed me here. But my daughter, Malon, is still back there—stuck working for Ingo.I hope she's OK... A father worries...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: ロンロン牧場は インゴーっていう奴に乗っ取られちまって 今じゃインゴー牧場だーよ…オラは インゴーに追い出されちまって この有様娘のマロンは 牧場で働かされてるだーよ…マロン 元気にしてるだか…父さんは心配だーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Die Lon-Lon-Farm wurde von einem Gesellen namens Basil übernommen. Daher heißt sie nun auch Basil-Farm.Basil hat mich rausgeworfen, und deshalb bin ich jetzt hier. Meine Tochter, Malon, ist allerdings immer noch dort und arbeitet für Basil.Ich hoffe, dass es ihr gut geht... Als Vater mache ich mir große Sorgen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_106
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: *sigh* Here I am, lyin' around, sleepin' again. I should really get outta here and help out Malon, but...I can't go back to Lon Lon Ranch with things the way they are now.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: あぁ オラ また寝てただか早く マロンを助けてやらないといけないのに…でも 今のままじゃロンロン牧場には 帰れないだーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Oh... Ich bin schon wieder eingeschlafen, oder? Ich sollte mich auf den Weg machen und Malon helfen, aber...So, wie die Dinge derzeit stehen, kann ich gerade nicht zurück zur Lon-Lon-Farm gehen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_107
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Urghh... I can't stop worrying about Malon and the whole situation at Lon Lon Ranch...But there's nothing I can do while Ingo's in charge! I need to think of a way to deal with him first.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: ううぅ…ロンロン牧場とマロンが 心配だーよでも インゴーをなんとかしないと牧場には帰れないだーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Hach... Ich mache mir ja solche Sorgen, um Malon und auch um die Lon-Lon-Farm...Aber solange Basil da das Sagen hat, gibt es nichts, was ich tun könnte! Was mach ich nur mit ihm...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_108
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: *sigh* I'm worried about my daughter, Malon.But Ingo's in charge of Lon Lon Ranch now. I don't even know what I could do to help...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: はぁ～…娘のマロンが心配だーよでも ロンロン牧場はインゴーに乗っ取られてるしどうしたものだーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Seufz... Ich mache mir solche Sorgen um meine Tochter, Malon.Aber jetzt hat dieser Basil auf der Lon-Lon-Farm das Sagen. Wie kann ich ihr nur helfen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: ...Mmrrrgh.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: …ハッ！ マロン！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Oh... Malon!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: マロンーー！！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Malon! Ich eile!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_112
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Oh, it's you... What do you need, son?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: なんだ にいさんか…何か用だか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Oh, du bist es... Wie kann ich dir helfen, junger Mann?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_113
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: *sigh* I'm so worried about Malon, my daughter back at Lon Lon Ranch...But with the way things are right now...I just can't muster the gumption to go back.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: はぁ～…娘のマロンが心配だーよ…でも 今のままじゃ…ロンロン牧場には 帰れないだーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Ach... Ich mache mir Sorgen um Malon, meine Tochter. Sie ist noch auf der Lon-Lon-Farm...Aber so, wie die Dinge jetzt gerade stehen... traue ich mich einfach nicht, dorthin zurückzukehren.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_114
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: Thanks, son...but what do I do?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: ありがとだーよううぅ… でもどうすればいいだーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Danke, junger Mann... Aber was soll ich nur tun?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.Label: Talk_115
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: *sigh* I really should get back so I can help Malon out as soon as I possibly can...But I'm no use to her or Lon Lon Ranch right now. I don't know what to do...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.JPjaText: はぁ～…一刻も早く マロンを助けてやらないと…でも ロンロン牧場には 帰れないだーよどうすればいいだーよ…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.EUdeText: Ach... Ich muss so schnell wie möglich zurück und Malon retten.Dabei weiß ich noch nicht mal, wie ich ihr oder der Lon-Lon-Farm überhaupt helfen könnte... Was soll ich nur tun?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Adult_Kakar.USenText: I'm up, I'm up... Ya don't need to be sneakin' up on me like that, son.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: …はいはい 起きてますだーよ妖精ぼうやもし 時間があるなら 遊んでいくだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Hö? Ich bin wach, bin wach!Wenn das mal nicht das Feenkind ist. Hast du etwas Freizeit, ja? Dann komm, lass uns spielen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_02
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Ya got 30 seconds to get the job done, OK? Alright, now, here we go.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 持ち時間は 30秒だーよそんじゃ いくだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Du hast 30 Sekunden dafür, in Ordnung? Gut, dann geht’s gleich los.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_03
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Alright, time's up! That was a solid try, son! These cuccos rake in the dough like nobody's business, yes sir, yes sir... A fine flock indeed!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 時間切れだ～よ 残念でした～っ！よしよし ホント よく かせぐいい コッコちゃん達だ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: So, die Zeit ist rum! Das war doch ein passabler Versuch!Ach ja, mit diesen Hühnern lässt sich im Handumdrehen Geld verdienen... Eine ganz großartige Hühnerschar ist das!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_04
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: That's one! Keep it up! Just two more!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: そいつは 当たりだーよ！その調子！ あと 2羽～っ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Da ist schon eins! Weiter so! Nur noch 2 mehr!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_05
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: There's another one! Alright, now, just one left!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: そいつも 当たりだ！さあ！ あと 1羽～っ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Da ist noch eins! Konzentration! 1 Huhn gilt es noch zu finden!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_06
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Amazing! That's all of 'em! Now head back over here!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: スゴイだ～よ！！ それで全部だーよ！こっちへ おいで！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Enorm! Du hast alle gefunden! Dann komm doch hierher zurück!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_07
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Wanna try again? Ya wouldn't go quittin' on a loss, would ya? Just find all three within 30 seconds!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: もう一度 ちょ～せんするだか？なんといっても 若者は やる気が肝心だーよ30秒以内に 3羽当てるだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Noch mal? Wenn man verloren hat, hört man nicht auf, oder? Finde einfach alle 3 Hühner in 30 Sekunden.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_08
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: You must have an eye for livestock! Ya wanna marry Malon and take over the ranch one day?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: ぼうやには きっと 動物を見極める才能があるだーよ！マロンのムコさんになって牧場を継がね～だか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Du hast ein gutes Auge für Tiere.Na, möchtest du Malon heiraten und eines Tages die Farm übernehmen?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_09
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Hah! I was only kidding! Just a joke, little buddy! Still a bit young for that, aren't ya? Aah-hahaha! Alright. As promised, here ya go...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: いや～ じょーだん じょーだん！まだ ちっちゃすぎるだか？ わはははっ！そーだ 約束通り オラの自慢の…
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Haha! Ich mach doch nur Witze! War nur Spaß, kleiner Mann! Du bist dafür noch etwas jung, hm? Aaah-hahaha!Gut... Also, wie versprochen...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_09_2
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: One bottle of Lon Lon milk! Cheers!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: ロンロン牛乳 やるだーよ！

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_10
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: That's some eye ya got there, little buddy! Got any interest in workin' on this ranch when ya grow up?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: ぼうや いい目してるだなー！おっきくなったら この牧場で働かねえだか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Gute Augen, das muss ich dir lassen, junger Mann! Willst du mal hier auf der Farm arbeiten, wenn du groß bist?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_11
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Take this Lon Lon milk as a reward!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: じゃ ごほうびのロンロン牛乳持って行くだ！

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_12
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Thank ya for your purchase! Now then, got an empty bottle for me?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: まいどだーよじゃ あきビンを貸すだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Danke für den Kauf! Also, hast du auch eine leere Flasche für mich?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_13
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: The fairy child's here to pay us a little visit, eh? Well, you can find Malon outside.Oh, not here to play with her, huh? I suppose that means you're here for me, then?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: …ああ 妖精ぼうやだか？マロンなら 外だーよあれ 遊びに来たんじゃないだか？ってことは オラに用事だか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Oho, das Feenkind ist zurück! Wenn du Malon suchst, sie ist draußen...Ach so, du bist gar nicht hier, um zu spielen? Dann möchtest du wohl zu mir?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_14
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: はいはい オラに用事だか？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Hm? Hast du etwas für mich?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_15
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Huh? Well, well! If it isn't the fairy child from the castle! Boy, do I owe you one! But since you're here... If ya got some free time, we could play a little game! The rules are dirt simple. All ya gotta do is find all three super cuccos.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: んっ？ 誰かと思ったら こないだの妖精ぼうや！あの時は 助かっただーよそうだ！ もし 時間があるならちょこっと 遊んでいくだルールは簡単！3羽のスーパーコッコを 見つけるだけ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Hm? Sieh einer an! Das ist doch das Feenkind vom Schloss! Dir habe ich einiges zu verdanken!Also, da du schon mal hier bist... Lass uns doch ein kleines Spiel spielen, wenn du etwas Zeit hast!Die Regeln sind ganz simpel. Du musst einfach nur alle drei Superhühner finden.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_16
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: また いつでも 来るだーよ

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_17
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Wuh-oh! Looks like you're a bit light on rupees. Come on back after ya save up some allowance.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: おおっと ルピーが 足りないだーよお小遣い貯めて また来るだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Oh nein! Dafür reichen deine Rubine nicht ganz. Komm wieder, wenn du dein Taschengeld gespart hast.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_18
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: It'll run ya 10 rupees. Whaddaya say?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 10ルピー もらうけど やる？
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Kostet dich 10 Rubine. Was meinst du?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_19
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: How about one round for five rupees?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Wie wäre es mit einer Runde für 5 Rubine?

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: It'll run ya 30 rupees. That OK?
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 30ルピーになるけど いいだか？

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_21
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Zzz... Just a few more minutes, Malon... *snort*

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Zzz... Nur noch etwas länger, Malon... Schnarch...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_27
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: This here's my little side hustle... I call it— uh-HEM—the cucco-findin' game!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: これがオラ考案の 小遣いかせ………ゴホッゴホッ… コッコ当てゲームだーよ！
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Das hier ist meine kleine Nebenbeschäftigung... Ich nenne sie... ähem... Superhuhnsuche!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_28
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: After ya finish your milk, bring your bottle back, and I'll give ya a refill for just 30 rupees.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 飲み終わっても そのビン持ってくれば30ルピーで 売ってあげるだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Wenn du die Milch getrunken hast, bring deine Flasche zurück und ich fülle sie dir wieder auf, für nur 30 Rubine.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_29
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Find 'em all, and I'll give you the best prize I've got—some of the good stuff: Lon Lon milk!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: もし 見つけられたらオラ自慢の ロンロン牛乳やるだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Finde alle von ihnen und ich geb dir etwas von der guten Lon-Lon-Milch!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_30
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: One swig of this is sure to cure whatever ails ya! I'm so confident in the quality, I even throw in a free refillable bottle for first-time winners.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 飲めばたちまち元気になる 自慢の一品だ～よ最初はビンも オマケしとくだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Trink einen Schluck davon und schon geht es dir besser! Ich sag dir was, bei deinem ersten Sieg geb ich dir eine wiederbefüllbare Flasche gratis dazu.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_33
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Alright, let me set up. Just one moment...
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: よし じゃあ準備するからちょっくら 待つだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Gut, dann lass mich mal alles vorbereiten. Einen Moment...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Whoa-hoho there... You feelin' alright, little guy? Get a hold of yourself!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Wah-hoho... Ist alles in Ordnung, junger Freund? Komm, reiß dich zusammen.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: *mumble* *mumble* Welcome...Enjoy your time...at our ranch... Zzz...

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Well, that's too bad. Come back later on, then.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 残念だーよまた 来るだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Ach, zu schade. Komm doch später noch mal wieder.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Gotta keep you youngsters motivated. Now do your best!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Euch junge Leute muss man bei Laune halten. Und jetzt streng dich schön an!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: If ya find 'em all, you win! If ya don't, I win.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Wenn du es schaffst, sie alle zu finden, hast du gewonnen! Und wenn nicht, dann gewinne ich.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Ehrlich gesagt... Sie ist von uns beiden die Verantwortungsvollere.

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_66
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: ワハハハハ！ すまんすまん

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_68
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Hey there, fairy child. Got some free time, do ya? Then c'mon, let's play!
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: 妖精ぼうやもし 時間があるなら 遊んでいくだ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Hallo, Feenkind. Hast gerade nichts zu tun, ja? Dann komm, lass uns spielen!

EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.Label: Talk_69
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.USenText: Careful there... We don't want you gettin' hurt.
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.JPjaText: まったく何してるだーよ…ケガしないように 気を付けるだーよ
EventFlowMsg/Npc_Hylia_Talon_Child.csv.EUdeText: Vorsichtig... Wir wollen doch nicht, dass du dir weh tust.
